body.p: About 12 last night I saw the government Dispatch announce Gen Sherman's capture of Savannah & have been reading the particulars to-day. It is a good termination to as fine ahis masterly nobility movement as from Altanta ‸down through the centre of Georgia. & I rejoice at it. Here I For all that I feel rather depressed with the Day.
